_meta.club_note: Club ids are MLB Stats API ids: 137 = San Francisco Giants, 133 = Athletics. Both are flagged high priority in the UI. Exhibition rows can list opponents that are not MLB clubs (national teams, college squads); the club filter offers the 30 MLB clubs.
header: MLB 2026 schedule - all clubs, all game types
time_tbd=true means the league has not published a first pitch; date_local is still official.

_meta.description: Every 2026 MLB game returned by the league's own schedule API for clubs and all game types (Spring Training, regular season, postseason, All-Star Game). Committed so a reviewer can read the fixture list without network access; regenerated by scripts/export_mlb_schedule.py in GitHub Actions.
_meta.validated_in_ci: Yes - the workflow fails if the fetch, normalization or validation raises.
_meta.caveat: The API is the league of record for fixtures. It is not a guarantee against later rescheduling, and `time_tbd=true` rows mean the first pitch is genuinely unpublished.

Every row is a league-published fixture; the last field is the league's game_pk, which a reviewer can look up. A blank start time means the league has not published a first pitch yet; the date is still official.
